BiblicalUsage: Nabluth is disgrace or lewdness, and its only occurrence is God uncovering faithless Israel. In Hosea 2:10 the Lord says He will discover her lewdness in the sight of her lovers, and none shall deliver her out of His hand.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the uncovering is judgment, but it is also honesty, because God will not let a people pretend; what is hidden will be shown, and the showing is the first step back.
